sections.title: Transport eligibility
sections.text: Atlas Labs employees in grades G3 and above who live at least 5 km from the office are eligible for regular cab transport.

sections.title: Night shift safety escort
sections.text: For women employees at Atlas Labs, drops after 7 PM require a security escort. An escort is not required by this rule for a drop exactly at 7 PM.

sections.title: Booking and change cutoff
sections.text: Atlas Labs cab bookings and shift changes must be requested at least 2 hours before the scheduled trip. Late exceptions require the transport manager's approval.

sections.title: Weekend and holiday travel
sections.text: Atlas Labs provides Saturday pickups only with prior line manager approval. Sunday and public holiday pickups require transport manager approval.

sections.title: Airport trip approvals
sections.text: Airport cab trips at Atlas Labs require prior approval from the department head. The approved airport trip cost cap is INR 1500 per trip.

sections.title: No show penalties
sections.text: At Atlas Labs, two no-shows within a calendar month lead to a 7-day suspension of cab booking access. The transport desk reviews disputes.

sections.title: Guest travel
sections.text: Guests and family members may not use Atlas Labs employee cabs. Employees must arrange separate travel for guests.

sections.title: Ad hoc trip requests
sections.text: Atlas Labs ad hoc office cab trips require transport manager approval and have a cost cap of INR 800 per trip.
